Flight · Romania

Drone of unknown origin flies along Chilia branch in Romania

13 August 2026 · Chilia branch

Reported cross-border incursion

On the night of 12–13 August 2026 a drone (UAV) entered Romanian airspace and flew for about 10 minutes along the Chilia branch, then left towards Ukraine, exiting around 13 km southwest of Chilia Veche. The Romanian military monitored the flight. Explosions were reported after the drone left, but no impact in Romania has been established.

The drone's nationality and operator have not been established, and its identity remains unresolved.

Romanian F-16s also responded to a later target nearby. The overnight track was reported alongside the discovery of drone fragments at Costinești beach the same day, but the two have not been linked, and the drone's relationship to later recoveries is unresolved.
